ruling.fardHelp: Obligatory — an essential part; the prayer is not valid without it.
ruling.wajibHelp: Necessary — a required act below the level of a pillar in some schools; if left out by mistake it is normally made up with the prostration of forgetfulness (sujud as-sahw).
ruling.sunnahHelp: Established practice of the Prophet ﷺ — rewarded; the prayer remains valid without it.
ruling.optionalHelp: Permissible; may be done or left.
ruling.conditionHelp: A precondition (shart) for the prayer to be valid.
ruling.notPracticedHelp: Not part of this school's standard practice.

about.title: About Learn Salah
about.p1: Learn Salah is an interactive guide that teaches the movements, recitations and structure of the prayer by showing them on a faceless 3D figure, synchronised with clear instructions.
about.p2: All instructional content is kept separate from the interface so it can be reviewed and corrected by qualified scholars. Where the four Sunni schools of law differ, the guide shows the selected school's practice and lets you compare the others, without presenting any one as the only correct view.
about.p3: The 3D figure deliberately has no face or identifiable features. Audio recitations will only be added once verified recordings are available.
about.reviewBody: The content is currently a draft. Every step lists the sources it relies on. Please report errors so they can be corrected after review.
about.principle2: No invented rulings; differences between schools are shown, not ranked.
about.principle3: Works without an account; progress stays on your device.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: References used across the guide. Hadith numbering follows the widely used sunnah.com numbering; Qur'an references are surah:ayah.
sources.banner: This content is a draft prepared for review by a qualified scholar. References are given so every statement can be checked.
